task_metadata.research_question: Design a novel generative architecture for antibody complementarity-determining region (CDR) loop sequence-structure co-design conditioned on the antigen-antibody framework context.
notes: Baselines were mapped to exact method papers.
All three test splits map to the CHIMERA-Bench benchmark paper.

tests.label: antigen_fold
tests.notes: CHIMERA-Bench split for unseen antigen folds.

baselines.name: diffab
baselines.notes: DiffAb is the diffusion-based antibody CDR co-design baseline.

baselines.name: dymean
baselines.notes: dyMEAN is the end-to-end full-atom antibody design baseline.

baselines.name: mean
baselines.notes: MEAN is the conditional antibody CDR design baseline.
